messages:
Priya: Quick sync — planning v3.2.1 release next Wed. Proposing rollout order and windows across zones: EU canary -> US primary -> APAC full. Concrete times (UTC): EU canary 2026-06-10 02:00, US 2026-06-10 08:00, APAC 2026-06-10 20:00. Branch cutoff for release branch at 2026-06-09 18:00 UTC (only hotfixes after). Changelog PR is #492 — Jordan can you nudge docs? Also adding graceful fallback + model-variant policy to the release config.

Jordan: Ack. I can push the changelog nudge today. Do we want a patch (3.2.1) or bump minor? Need to be explicit so CI/packaging tags correctly.

Mike: Prefer patch (3.2.1) unless we're shipping breaking or opt-in user-facing features. What's in the changelog exactly?

Priya: Mostly bugfixes and an infra perf toggle behind a feature-flag (disabled by default). Patch is correct. I'll add a short note about the toggle under "notes" in the changelog.

Sara: Ops note: EU canary will be on a reduced pool (2 GPUs) for 2h, then scale to 6 if health checks pass. I'll schedule the autoscaler warmup 30m before the canary. Need deploy-bot to run KV-cache prewarm before traffic.

deploy-bot: Scheduled jobs:
```
kv-prewarm-job --region eu --at 2026-06-10T01:30:00Z
kv-prewarm-job --region us --at 2026-06-10T07:30:00Z
kv-prewarm-job --region apac --at 2026-06-10T19:30:00Z
ci-smoke-tests --after prewarm
```
CI smoke tests will run automatically after prewarm completes.

Nina: Can we lock branch protection (no force-pushes, require PR reviews) at cutoff? I can flip the protection flag at cutoff time unless someone objects.

Jordan: +1 to locking. Also tagging reviewers on the changelog + release PR: @mike @sara @nina.

Priya: Quick commands for releasers (copy/paste):
```
git checkout -b release/v3.2.1
git merge --no-ff main
./scripts/bump-version.sh 3.2.1
./scripts/generate-changelog.sh > CHANGELOG.md
```
Final checklist: 1) Branch cutoff 2026-06-09 18:00 UTC, 2) Changelog PR merged by 2026-06-09 17:00 UTC, 3) EU canary 2026-06-10 02:00 UTC, 4) Autoscaler warmup + prewarm 30m prior, 5) Post-rollout smoke & perf checks + rollback plan. Drop :thumbsup: if you’re good or post blockers.

Mike: :thumbsup: no blockers from infra side.

Sara: Will monitor autoscaler logs and post a short status in this thread when warmup is scheduled.

Nina: I'll prepare the branch-protection change and hold until cutoff.

Jordan: I'll merge changelog by EOD today and ping once done.

Priya: Thanks all — will post a final runbook and timeline tomorrow. If anyone needs different windows (hard constraints for APAC teams), speak now.
